stories.title: Saltney Ferry residents unable to register with a GP, Senedd told
stories.summary: Residents in Saltney Ferry are unable to register with a GP and are crossing the border into England to access primary care, a north Wales MS has told the Senedd. stories.title: Buyer sought for Colomendy site near Mold as Liverpool City Council appoints agent
stories.summary: Liverpool City Council has put Colomendy, a 106-acre outdoor education site near Mold, up for sale, more than a year after it closed when its operator went into administration. stories.summary: Flintshire County Council is being asked to demand answers from Cabinet over why taxpayers face an estimated £30 million borrowing bill for a Catholic super-school building that would be handed to the Diocese of Wrexham on completion. stories.title: Flintshire firm’s staff complete 53-mile coast relay from Conwy to Saltney
stories.summary: Colleagues from P&A Group completed a 53-mile charity relay along the North Wales Coast Path on Saturday 13 June, raising around £1,500 for Tenovus Cancer Care and North Wales Wildlife Trust.
